{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Taoqi |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Take your time and enjoy the journey. Don't hurry too much, or you may miss out on all the beautiful sights along the way. You don't want to reach the end of the road with nothing to show for it. Hehe... Just some tips from someone who's been there before. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = I wasn't slacking off, really. I just needed to recharge a little... Aww, you don't believe me? Don't say that. I'll be so hurt. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = It does get overwhelming with so many people counting on you. I know that feeling all too well... Worry not. You can relax a little more when you're with me. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Oh... I fell asleep? ...Hehe, I guess your presence just made me feel that much more at ease. You should get more rest too, Rover. Staying up late too much could lead to hair loss. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = The danger in the air is palpable nowadays. I guess that's why you have come to our aid at a time like this. How unfortunate, I have been hoping to enjoy a peaceful life with you... Anyway. Rover, would you come a little closer? Let's have some leisurely time together, even if only for a little while. |vo_02_01_title = Taoqi's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Had a great sleep. Ugh... time for work... Gotta get up... but... still 'eepy... Just one more nap... |vo_02_02_title = Taoqi's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = I am fully booked for afternoon consultings well into next year, and I heard someone is reselling bookings at high prices... I didn't know it would spiral into this. Honestly, I don't believe my input made much of a difference—in the end, it was up to themselves to solve their own issues. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = I'm all about the easy-to-eat stuff. Give me some creamy, savory porridge any day. Can you help me out with this spoonful? It's a little bit too hot for my tongue. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Hmm... food that requires peeling, I guess. Why? It's too much hassle. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I really hate working. That said, I've got to put in some effort now so one day I won't have to work anymore. Haha, sure, I could just retire by myself if I want to... but I'm hoping to ease the load off of everyone else once and for all, so we can all enjoy a peaceful life together. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = How do you like it here in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}}? Enjoying your stay? It is my dream to make it a truly safe and cozy place to live, free from all the border city dangers. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = In the past, my friends were always there for me, shielding me from harm. Their presence was steadfast like the city walls, providing me a great sense of security and comfort. That is why I am now driven to build stronger walls for all citizens of Jinzhou, so everyone can enjoy the same comfort and reassurance. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Jinhsi]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Jinhsi.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = People think Lady Jinhsi is too young to lead, but I don't see the problem. Her young age may be seen as a disadvantage, but it's also her greatest strength. As we work on moving Jinzhou forward, she will go further and accomplish more than any of us can imagine. |vo_04_01_mention = Jinhsi |vo_04_02_title = About [[Sanhua]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Sanhua.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Oh, I wish I had someone like Sanhua. Imagine how much easier my work would be with her help. Where on earth did Lady Jinhsi find herself such an incredible bodyguard? I'll have to ask her about it next time we meet. |vo_04_02_mention = Sanhua, Jinhsi |vo_04_03_title = About [[Xiangli Yao]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Xiangli Yao.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Mr. Xiangli? Yes, he is a great collaborator of ours at the {{Extra Effect|Ministry of Development|Ministry of Development|The Ministry of Development serves as the engineering and construction arm of the Central Office of State Affairs.
It is comprised of three key divisions: the Ordnance and Defense Divisions, which handle all military applications. And the Infrastructure Division, tasked with public works and construction projects.}}. Our work partially overlaps with the Academy's research projects, and I consult him daily. Despite his genius intellect and quick thinking, I have no issue keeping up with his ideas. |vo_04_03_mention = Xiangli Yao |vo_04_04_title = About [[Jiyan]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Jiyan.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = General Jiyan's schedule is always so impossibly tight... He seems to keep finding more issues to take care of, like a devoted parent who never allows himself any rest. Maybe it's his doctor instincts, always putting others first. I really hope he can take some time off for his own well-being. |vo_04_04_mention = Jiyan |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = It's your birthday today. You should take a well-deserved rest. Let's nap together, shall we? I've got the comfiest sleep gear just for you. Sweet dreams, and happy birthday, dear. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Perfect weather for a walk today... Hmm, maybe not... |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = More paperwork? Let's see... *satisfied smile* All set. Now, what should I have for dinner? |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Sometimes I pretend I was a cloud in the sky... Just drifting by as a soft and fluffy pile, without any worry. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Hi there, I'm Taoqi, in charge of border defense at the {{Extra Effect|Ministry of Development}}. If you need my help, shoot me a message any time. I'll get back to you during work hours. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Time for another afternoon consultation, I see. What's on your mind today? |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = No need to rush. Everything will work out in due time. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = I'll take good care of you. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Time to work? *chuckle* No more lazing around, then. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = I feel so good right now, I'd say even better than when I just took a seven-day leave. Thank you for your help, Rover. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = My heart is beating faster, and I can hear my blood rushing... This newfound strength is making me feel a bit restless. Maybe I should go get some sleep. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = With more power comes more responsibility... I really don't want more work, but if it's you asking... I can do some overtime. Just a little. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = Thank you. You're so reliable, my darling little one. Hmm? You might have actually lived longer than me. Hehe... Now that I'm stronger than ever, I just want to take care of you like a big sister. Can't you just let me? |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = You have opened my eyes to things I've never noticed before. Safety isn't found in one person building a "wall." It comes from supporting each other, and cherishing shared moments. Thank you for always being here for me. If we could stay like this forever, I... Hmm? You didn't catch that last sentence?
